text:
maria-cs: Hey team — Havenbrook pre-go-live check. Customer flagged two items: their KMS key shows rotation=false and audit logs haven't started forwarding to the S3 bucket. They also asked about 365d retention options for private deploy. Any blockers?

raj-infra: I'm on KMS. Their CMK is customer-managed and rotation is off. I can enable key rotation but want to confirm no objections — enabling rotation is non-disruptive for decrypt operations. @maria-cs any legal/ops signoff needed?

kevin-se: For audit logs, our agent shows: `403 AccessDenied: PutObject` to the bucket. Looks like the bucket policy doesn't include our deployment role.

olivia-se: Quick remediation commands if helpful: ```aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh```
Also need to add s3 policy stmt granting `s3:PutObject` to role arn:aws:iam::444444444444:role/redwood-priv-role — their current policy restricts by user rather than role.

maria-cs: Thanks. Customer texted: "if logs aren't compliant we will delay the cutover" — flagging renewal risk. They were surprised docs didn't call out role-policy shape.

raj-infra: If we enable rotation + fix bucket policy, logs should flow within ~2 hours. For retention: propose 90d hot + 275d archival to Glacier to support 365d retention without a big cost hit. Want me to propose that to Havenbrook?

maria-cs: Yes, please propose the 90/275 split and include a rough cost delta. Also capture feedback: they said onboarding docs for 'priv deploy logging' are sparse and the installer error messages were cryptic.

kevin-se: I'll add a validation to the installer to check for expected role ARN pattern and error with: `Expected role ARN in bucket policy: arn:aws:iam::\d{12}:role/redwood-priv-role`. Will open PR today.

olivia-se: ETA for PR + staging deploy: 6-8 hrs. Can run a dry run with Havenbrook 09:00 PT tomorrow.

maria-cs: Action items: raj — enable rotation + draft retention proposal; kevin — patch installer validation and error; olivia — schedule dry run; i'll update renewal scorecard (currently amber => can move green if resolved).

maria-cs: Quick question: any objections to enabling rotation now? It is non-disruptive but want to be explicit.

raj-infra: No objections. Enabling rotation now.

deploy-bot: deploy started for branch fix/enhance-logging at 3245678945

raj-infra: rotation enabled ✅ — 3245678952. I informed the customer.

deploy-bot: staging deploy finished successfully at 3245678956 — checks green

raj-infra: first log events received at 3245678958, sample shows PutObject success and a few CloudTrail lines.

maria-cs: Excellent. Updating renewal scorecard to green. I'll open a docs ticket to add a section on required bucket policy and expected role ARN. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

maria-cs: I'll follow up with Havenbrook with the retention proposal and the ETA for the dry run.
